Extra columns do no harm; a missing column or a wrong set of rows does.

1. Row grain — what one row of the final result stands for ("one row per customer", "a single row holding the answer").
2. Row count — only what the question itself fixes: exactly 1, exactly N (when the question states N), or one per <entity>. Read to the END of the question before deciding.
